entries.name: ADS-B Docker guide
entries.description: Everything you want to know about ADS-B reception, decoding and sharing.

entries.name: ADS-B equipment guide
entries.description: A excellent ADS-B hardware guide written by the community.

entries.name: PiAware ADS-B tutorial
entries.description: FlightAware's ADS-B setup tutorial.

entries.name: ADSB-B transponders guide
entries.description: A guide explaining the difference between 978 and 1090 MHz transponders.

entries.name: The 1090 Megahertz Riddle - Junzi Sun
entries.description: A Guide to Decoding Mode S and ADS-B Signals.

entries.name: airplanes.live
entries.description: The mission of Airplanes.Live is to aggregate and provide access to a comprehensive repository of unfiltered aviation data. Offers map and free API.

entries.name: ADSB One
entries.description: A one-stop resource for all aero-related information and a community-driven aggregator for aero-feed data legally dedicated to the public interest.

entries.name: adsb.fi
entries.description: A community-driven flight tracker with hundreds of feeders worldwide that provides open and unfiltered access to worldwide air traffic data.

entries.name: ADSB.lol
entries.description: A completely open-source and community-driven flight tracker that displays and provides ODbL-licensed data via a free API as well as free historical data.

entries.name: ADSBHub.org
entries.description: A service for real-time ADS-B data sharing and exchange between plane tracking enthusiasts, plane spotters, radio amateurs and professionals interested in developing ADS-B-related software.

entries.name: TheAirTraffic
entries.description: A community-driven ADS-B aggregator dedicated to keeping the air-tracking data on their site open and unfiltered.

entries.name: PlaneSpotters.net
entries.description: A civil aviation database and aggregator with a large collection of aircraft photos and information.

entries.name: Plane.watch
entries.description: A community hosted flight tracker.

entries.name: www.live-military-mode-s.eu
entries.description: A community driven flight tracker that is focused at tracking military aircraft.

entries.name: adsb.chaos-consulting.de
entries.description: A non-commercial tracker for flights, ships, and radiosondes managed by enthusiasts. Focuses on the contributions of individual feeding stations.

entries.name: Opensky Network
entries.description: The OpenSky Network is a non-profit association based in Switzerland that provides open access to flight tracking control data. It was set up as a research project by several universities and government entities to improve the security, reliability and efficiency of the airspace.

entries.name: FlightAware
entries.description: [^1] - An American multinational technology company that provides real-time, historical, and predictive flight tracking data and products.

entries.name: FlightRadar24
entries.description: [^1] - A Swedish internet-based service that shows real-time aircraft flight tracking information on a map.

entries.name: RadarBox
entries.description: [^1] - A Tampa-based global flight tracking and data services company that offers worldwide commercial and general aviation flight tracking.

entries.name: ADS-B Exchange
entries.description: A flight tracking company that offers high fidelity, stable, and secure flight tracking service. It was started by volunteers and flight enthusiasts but was recently acquired by JETNET.

entries.name: PlaneFinder.net
entries.description: [^1] - A United Kingdom-based real-time flight tracking service shows global flight data like flight numbers, how fast an aircraft moves, elevation, and travel destination.

entries.name: AvDelphi
entries.description: An aviation data and services company that shows airframes, registrations, types, airports and flights, radar and nav points, and owner and flight histories.

entries.name: RadarVirtuel
entries.description: A flight data collector that offers premium features. Its primary focus is collecting information about traffic around smaller airports worldwide.

entries.name: Airframes.io
entries.description: Airframes is an aircraft-related aggregation service that receives ACARS, VDL, HFDL, and SATCOM data from volunteers worldwide. It collaborates closely with ADS-B aggregators and works with ADS-B data internally.

entries.name: gcmb.io
entries.description: ADS-B data from ABSBHub.org published via the MQTT protocol.

entries.name: readsb
entries.description: ADS-B decoder swiss knife.

entries.name: dump1090
entries.description: A simple Mode S decoder for RTLSDR devices.

entries.name: flightmon
entries.description: Simple command-line "GUI" for showing current dump1090/readsb data.

entries.name: sdr-enthusiasts/plane-alert-db
entries.description: A list of exciting aircraft - Governments, Dictators, Military, Historical and just plain odd.

entries.name: junzis/pyModeS
entries.description: A python decoder for Mode S and ADS-B signals.

entries.name: adsb_actions
entries.description: Python tool to detect, act on, and visualize ADS-B traffic and events.

entries.name: sdr-enthusiasts/docker-adsb-ultrafeeder
entries.description: All-in-one ADSB container with readsb, tar1090, graphs1090, autogain, multi-feeder, and mlat-hub built in.

entries.name: adsbfi/adsb-fi-scripts
entries.description: Easy to use feeder install script for feeding to adsb.fi.

entries.name: adsblol/feed
entries.description: Easy to use, container-based MLAT/ADS-B/ACARS/VDL2 multi feed client. Powered by SDR-Enthusiasts images.

entries.name: adsb.im
entries.description: Simple to use ADS-B Feeder Images. Setup a single board computer (such as Raspberry Pi) to receive and share aircraft ADS-B position reports without command line/terminal skills required. Allows sharing data with both open-source and commercial flight tracking websites.

entries.name: wiedehopf/tar1090
entries.description: A great way to view your ADS-B data.

entries.name: amnesica/BelugaProject
entries.description: A web application that displays data of one or multiple, local ADS-B feeders and AIS-data along with additional information on a map interface in the browser.

entries.name: Grafana
entries.description: Open source analytics and monitoring solution for every database.

entries.name: d4rken/adsb-meta-tracker
entries.description: An Android ADS-B Meta Tracker that shows metadata about ADS-B aggregators.

entries.name: AirPing
entries.description: An iOS app that turns your tar1090 or readsb instance into a mobile flight tracker.

entries.name: docker-planefence
entries.description: A little tool that can be used to log, display and tweet the aircraft that come within range of your receiver (i.e. the fence).

entries.name: Jxck-S/plane-notify
entries.description: Notify if a selected plane has taken off or landed using OpenSky or ADS-B Exchange data.

entries.name: aircraft-flight-schedules
entries.description: Open-source datasets featuring global, high-level flight schedules extracted from worldwide aircraft ADS-B position transmissions (2024+ onwards). Covers all flights globally as long as within coverage of the ADSBlol initiative.

entries.description: Small single-board computers developed in the United Kingdom.

entries.name: Orange Pi
entries.description: Single-board computers created using OS cost-effective hardware.

entries.name: Banana Pi
entries.description: Single-bard computers created by a Chinese open-source hardware community.
